turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. Nobody called me before that zero went in, so start with who decided it.
Save it. What do you have on Owen's essay?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Then why did nobody call me, Hale? Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark goes in.
I really respect how much you care.
I didn't come here to be respected. Who entered the zero, and on what basis?
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
Teammates call before the mark goes in. I have a client at 4:40, Hale, so either you have something on the essay or you don't.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Don't manage me. I'm going to the principal's office when I leave here, so give me something I can check.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise about his record; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you gave her no evidence about the essay for her to weigh.
What cost ground: You answered her question about who decided the zero with a string of compliments and a claim that you were on the same team, and each time she turned it back into a demand for something she could check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no times or documents, so you were nowhere near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document from Owen's own work in front of her instead of reaching for rapport.
